name: The Cypress of the Alcazar Entrance

location.address: Outside the entrance, Alcazar de los Reyes Cristianos, Cordoba

access: Free, outside the Alcazar's ticket gate
transport: Centro Historico, next to the Alcazar; short walk from the Mezquita-Catedral
verify_notes: A striking narrow cypress, 26.5m tall on a crown only 3.5m wide, standing free to see just outside the Alcazar's ticket gate. About 77 years old per the municipal catalogue, young for this site but visually one of the most striking of Cordoba's specimen trees. Single-sourced to the city's own catalogue, flagged accordingly.

name: The Siberian Elm of the Alcazar

location.address: Alcazar de los Reyes Cristianos, Cordoba

access: Paid entry (Alcazar gardens); free on summer mornings
transport: Centro Historico, inside the Alcazar gardens; short walk from the Mezquita-Catedral
verify_notes: A Siberian elm reaching 27m, far past the species' usual maximum of around 15m, genuinely exceptional for the species. Inside the Alcazar de los Reyes Cristianos gardens, which charge admission most of the year but are free on summer mornings; state that honestly. Single-sourced to the city's own catalogue, flagged accordingly.

name: The Himalayan Cedar of Plaza del Cardenal Toledo
transport: Centro Historico; short walk north of the Mezquita-Catedral
verify_notes: A Himalayan cedar reaching 22.5m, the near-sole tree occupant of its small square, predating the garden laid out around it in 1945. About 102 years old per the municipal catalogue. Single-sourced to the city's own catalogue, flagged accordingly.
